ace_trainer_snow_f.name: Trainer
dialog: Brrr! Snowpoint never warms up, not even in the middle of summer.
I wear three coats, and my Pokémon still have to huddle round me to keep me warm!

snowpoint_npc_f_1.name: Woman
dialog: Everybody in Snowpoint owns a good scarf. You can't get through a winter here without one.
Mine was knitted from Mareep wool. Soft, warm, and only a little bit static!

snowpoint_npc_f_2.name: Woman
dialog: Candice, our Gym Leader, has been teaching me how to battle!
She says the cold air keeps your mind sharp. Mostly it just makes my nose run.

snowpoint_npc_m.name: Man
dialog: There's an ancient temple at the top of town. I'd give anything to see what's inside.
Nobody gets past the woman standing at its door, though. Not even me, and I've lived here all my life.

sailor.name: Sailor
dialog: Ships put in here from all over. Snowpoint's a quiet stop, mind you. Not much ever happens.
After weeks out on a cold sea, though, a quiet town is just what a sailor wants.

temple_guard.name: Temple Guard
dialog: Behind me stands Snowpoint Temple, built in an age long before the town.
Only those the temple has chosen may enter. I'm sorry, but I cannot let you pass.

sailor_ss_spiral.name: Sailor
dialog: This ship sails north to the Battle Zone, where the strongest trainers in the land gather.
We only take trainers who have proved themselves at the Pokémon League. I'll be watching for you!
